mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) AS net, MIN(CASE WHEN l.entry_type = 'DEPOSIT' THEN l.created_at END) AS first_at FROM trading_ledger l JOIN trading_account a ON a.id = l.account_id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND l.bucket = 'BALANCE' AND l.entry_type IN ('DEPOSIT', 'DEPOSIT_REVERSAL') AND l.created_at >= #{since}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) FROM trading_ledger l JOIN trading_account a ON a.id = l.account_id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND l.bucket = 'BALANCE' AND l.entry_type = 'REALIZED_PNL' AND l.created_at >= #{since}
